title: When a resumed gate's tree is unchanged since the reviewer round, say so in the brief, with the diff hash, so the gate need not re-derive it

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-134755-11b1, project ork, item S419:

When a resumed gate's tree is unchanged since the reviewer round, say so in the brief, with the diff hash, so the gate need not re-derive it

Evidence: the status in the gate brief is identical to the reviewer round; I re-checked it by hand with git status and git diff --stat
